def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers_list = instance["customer_ids"]
    customers = set(customers_list)
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    # vehicle_count_hint may be used to limit effort, but not required for feasibility
    vhint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", max(1, len(customers_list) // 10))

    def route_load(r):
        s = 0
        for n in r:
            s += demands[n]
        return s

    def route_cost(r):
        if not r:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][r[0]]
        for i in range(len(r) - 1):
            c += matrix[r[i]][r[i + 1]]
        c += matrix[r[-1]][depot]
        return c

    def two_opt(route):
        n = len(route)
        if n < 4:
            return route
        best = route
        best_c = route_cost(best)
        improved = True
        # Deterministic first-improvement with restart on improvement
        while improved:
            improved = False
            best = route
            best_c = route_cost(best)
            for i in range(n - 1):
                a = route[i]
                b = route[i + 1]
                for k in range(i + 2, n):
                    if k == n - 1:
                        # endpoints involve depot already in cost; still valid to consider
                        pass
                    c = route[k]
                    d = route[k + 1] if k + 1 < n else None
                    # Compute delta on internal edges:
                    # Replace edges (a,b) and (c,d) with (a,c) and (b,d), where d is route[k+1]
                    if k + 1 < n:
                        delta = (matrix[a][route[k]] + matrix[route[i + 1]][route[k + 1]]) - (matrix[a][b] + matrix[route[k]][route[k + 1]])
                    else:
                        # k is last index, (c,d) doesn't exist as an internal edge; depot edges will be affected
                        # current last part edges: (route[k-1], route[k]) and (route[k], depot)
                        # but in 2-opt with k==last, we are reversing suffix ending at last, affecting edge (a,b) and depot edge
                        delta = (matrix[a][route[k]] + matrix[route[i + 1]][depot]) - (matrix[a][b] + matrix[route[k]][depot])
                    if delta < 0:
                        # apply reversal
                        new_route = route[:i + 1] + route[i + 1:k + 1][::-1] + route[k + 1:]
                        route = new_route
                        n = len(route)
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        return route

def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers_list = instance["customer_ids"]
    customers = set(customers_list)
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    # vehicle_count_hint may be used to limit effort, but not required for feasibility
    vhint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", max(1, len(customers_list) // 10))

    def route_load(r):
        s = 0
        for n in r:
            s += demands[n]
        return s

    def route_cost(r):
        if not r:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][r[0]]
        for i in range(len(r) - 1):
            c += matrix[r[i]][r[i + 1]]
        c += matrix[r[-1]][depot]
        return c

    def two_opt(route):
        n = len(route)
        if n < 4:
            return route
        best = route
        best_c = route_cost(best)
        improved = True
        # Deterministic first-improvement with restart on improvement
        while improved:
            improved = False
            best = route
            best_c = route_cost(best)
            for i in range(n - 1):
                a = route[i]
                b = route[i + 1]
                for k in range(i + 2, n):
                    if k == n - 1:
                        # endpoints involve depot already in cost; still valid to consider
                        pass
                    c = route[k]
                    d = route[k + 1] if k + 1 < n else None
                    # Compute delta on internal edges:
                    # Replace edges (a,b) and (c,d) with (a,c) and (b,d), where d is route[k+1]
                    if k + 1 < n:
                        delta = (matrix[a][route[k]] + matrix[route[i + 1]][route[k + 1]]) - (matrix[a][b] + matrix[route[k]][route[k + 1]])
                    else:
                        # k is last index, (c,d) doesn't exist as an internal edge; depot edges will be affected
                        # current last part edges: (route[k-1], route[k]) and (route[k], depot)
                        # but in 2-opt with k==last, we are reversing suffix ending at last, affecting edge (a,b) and depot edge
                        delta = (matrix[a][route[k]] + matrix[route[i + 1]][depot]) - (matrix[a][b] + matrix[route[k]][depot])
                    if delta < 0:
                        # apply reversal
                        new_route = route[:i + 1] + route[i + 1:k + 1][::-1] + route[k + 1:]
                        route = new_route
                        n = len(route)
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        return route

    def best_insertion_positions(routeB, node):
        # Return best (pos, delta_cost) inserting node into routeB; pos in [0..len]
        # delta assumes standard route cost with depot
        m = len(routeB)
        if m == 0:
            delta = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][depot]
            return 0, delta
        best_pos = 0
        best_delta = None
        # insert before routeB[pos]
        for pos in range(m + 1):
            if pos == 0:
                delta = (matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][routeB[0]]) - (matrix[depot][routeB[0]])
            elif pos == m:
                delta = (matrix[routeB[m - 1]][node] + matrix[node][depot]) - (matrix[routeB[m - 1]][depot])
            else:
                prev = routeB[pos - 1]
                nxt = routeB[pos]
                delta = (matrix[prev][node] + matrix[node][nxt]) - (matrix[prev][nxt])
            if best_delta is None or delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and pos < best_pos):
                best_delta = delta
                best_pos = pos
        return best_pos, best_delta

    def inter_route_relocate(routes):
        # deterministic first-improvement: move one node from a to b at best position
        # limit attempts for speed

    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = set(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    routes = []
    while customers:
        route = []
        load = 0
        current = depot
        while True:
            feasible = [node for node in customers if load + demands[node] <= capacity]
            if not feasible:
                break
            nxt = min(feasible, key=lambda node: (matrix[current][node], demands[node], node))
            route.append(nxt)
            customers.remove(nxt)
            load += demands[nxt]
            current = nxt
        routes.append(route)
    return routes
